description: This file defines a GWT (Google Web Toolkit) client-side component, specifically a custom cell implementation ToDoCell for rendering and interacting with ToDoItem objects within a web application's UI. It handles rendering in view/edit modes, user interactions, and events related to ToDo items.

classes.name: ToDoCell
classes.description: A custom GWT cell class for displaying and interacting with ToDoItem objects in a list, supporting view and edit modes, and handling user events such as toggling completion and deletion.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the ToDoItem in view or edit mode, constructing the HTML content with templates according to the current state.

methods.name: isEditing
methods.description: Determines if a specific ToDoItem is currently in edit mode.

methods.name: onBrowserEvent
methods.description: Handles DOM events such as clicks, key presses, and blurs to manage editing states and perform actions like toggling completion or deleting items.

methods.name: commitEdit
methods.description: Commits the current text input into the ToDoItem and fires an update event.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Switches the cell into edit mode for a specific ToDoItem, re-rendering the cell accordingly.

methods.name: endEdit
methods.description: Exits edit mode for the ToDoItem and updates the display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Re-renders the cell content and updates the DOM.

methods.name: getInputElement
methods.description: Retrieves the input element within the cell when in edit mode.

methods.name: getViewRootElement
methods.description: Retrieves the root div element in view mode.
